final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=device turns on if at least 5 objects are placed and objects 1, 2, and 4 are included
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4]; rule=device is on when exactly seven objects are placed on it, including both object 3 and object 4
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=device turns on if all 8 objects are placed or exactly 7 objects including objects 1, 4, and 7 are placed
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 6]; rule=any combination of at least 7 objects that includes object 2, object 3, and object 6
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=device turns on if all 8 objects are placed together OR at least six objects are placed that include objects 3, 4, and 5

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on when all eight objects are present or when exactly seven objects are present and include both object 1 and object 6.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=device turns on when all objects not initially on the device (objects 0, 4, 5, and 7) are placed on it together, regardless of additional objects present

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 2, object 4, object 6]; rule=device is on if and only if all even-numbered objects (0, 2, 4, 6) are placed on it – missing any even object causes it to remain off, regardless of other objects
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 3, object 4]; rule=objects 1, 3, and 4 must all be present together

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=device turns on when **all seven objects (0-6)** are placed together OR when exactly **six objects include both object 2 and 3**, **two consecutive-numbered objects from 4-6** (e.g., 4&5 or 5&6), and **object 7 may be optionally included** in any valid six-object set
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if and only if objects 1, 6, and 7 are all placed on it (other objects have no effect)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 2, object 4, object 6]; rule=device turns on if and only if all four even-numbered objects (0, 2, 4, 6) are included in the set, regardless of any additional objects
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=all three objects must be included in the set for the device to turn on
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=object 4 must be placed along with both object 0 and object 1
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if and only if object 0, object 1, and object 6 are all present together (additional objects have no effect)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 3, object 4]; rule=device turns on when object 0, object 1, object 3, and object 4 are all placed on the device simultaneously (no additional objects required)
